data.name: PagerDuty - Service Integration Webhook (create/incidents)
data.description:
Trigger a PagerDuty incident via the Service Integration webhook URL (service integration key) configured on your PagerDuty Service.
Documentation: https://docs.logicloop.com/actions/destinations/pagerduty
Quick Start:
- In PagerDuty, configure a Service Integration and get the integration/webhook URL.
- Create a PagerDuty action destination in LogicLoop and paste the integration webhook URL.
- LogicLoop will POST event payloads to that webhook URL when the rule triggers.
Parameters Explained:
- integrationWebhookUrl (required): The service-specific webhook URL from PagerDuty's service integrations page.
- Request body: JSON payload per PagerDuty Events API (you may include payload.summary, payload.source, routing_key etc. depending on which Events API version is used).
Common Errors & Fixes:
- 401/403: Invalid or missing integration key; ensure you used the exact webhook URL from PagerDuty.
- 400 Bad Request: Payload missing required fields or malformed JSON.
Edge Cases:
- If the same LogicLoop alert triggers twice quickly, LogicLoop attempts to attach to the existing incident where possible (per docs).
Rate Limits & Constraints:
- PagerDuty enforces rate limits on event ingestion; consult PagerDuty developer docs for specifics.
